scope: Retrospective decision audit of the already-opened holdout; no new model evaluation or fitting
policy: Use existing dev-readiness battery dispatch and its base cost assumptions without selecting settings on this replay
dst: Exclude 23/25-hour Berlin delivery days; no interpolated hours may enter the execution replay
separation: OS-isolated worker receives only one day's saved forecast; persist every decision and its hashes before scorer reads price_de outcomes
limits: Forecasts and decisions are historical simulations created now, not timestamped live orders
The original holdout has already been inspected; this is a retrospective diagnostic with no parameter selection
Source publication/revision vintages and foundation-model pretraining provenance are not independently proven
Hourly averaged prices are a proxy for actual quarter-hour products; full fills at the average are an assumption
Costs are illustrative; taxes, outages, imbalance risk and actual execution are excluded
Pre-gate mapping fits historically used past post-gate TSO forecasts as labels, not current-day post-gate inputs
